svg.title: Known-best packing of 105 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=105 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 260aaf5 rational centre/half-angle certificate converted exactly from a checkout at the pin whose bytes have the digests the packet records, and equal there to the source's own corners Witness/v2; no upstream byte is retained. Finite construction feasibility only; no local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.
